items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: That's where I started working with Kid Oliver and Ori and all of those different musicians, you know, P. Kool and Manuel Perez and all, you know, Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: When you sang at the halls, did they have a band?

Oh, sure. Or usually it would be what they call a concert and ball, meaning the concert would start at about 8, 8.30 and last until about 10, 30, 11 o'clock. Well, when it was given in halls like that in order to make money so they could charge, you know, 50 cents and 75 cents, they had to have a band. That's where I started working with Kid Oliver and Ori and all of those different musicians, you know, P. Kool and Manuel Perez and all, you know, Bunk Johnson. That's all of that. It's in those times that I sang…
Now, what about your name? We want to get that down straight. How did you happen to get the name Lizzie Miles?
